label: sub_013_coin_back_01
text: Lately, I’ve found a coin or two lying around.\nPerhaps folks have more than they can hold onto.

label: sub_013_coin_back_02
text: I picked up a coin while I was cleaning. Had a\nfeeling it was yours—here you go.

label: sub_013_coin_back_03
text: I picked up some coins while I was cleaning.\nHad a feeling they were yours—here you go.
